summary: DRDGOLD Limited filed a Form 6-K containing an operating update for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The report details production of 1,219 kg of gold, revenue of R2,963.1 million, and operating profit of R1,854.0 million. It notes a 6% increase in gold production quarter-over-quarter and reiterates FY2026 production guidance of 140,000-150,000 ounces. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situations event is announced. This is a routine quarterly operational filing, not a special situation.
